commentary.title: A multi-week shift
commentary.body: Two completed weeks were meaningfully below your prior 28-night baseline. No downstream training constraint was established.

caveat: Sleep uses the prior 28 reliable nights and excludes this period. Foam rolling cannot set the Recovery status. Associations do not imply causation.
